test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.

Praveen told his mother that he had completed his homework.

options.text: Praveen said to his mother, “I have been completing my homework.”
Praveen said to his mother, “I have completed my homework.”
Praveen said to his mother, “I am completing my homework.”
Praveen said to his mother, “He had completed my homework.”

solution: The correct answer is '2' i.e. Praveen said to his mother, “I have completed my homework.”
